description:
Cosmic Pioneer is a solo project by Mounabrata Sarkar tackling the Dancing with the SARs challenge. Combining machine learning, Python data pipelines, and interactive 3D geospatial visualization, I am building a real-time surface-change detection tool powered by NISAR Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data to translate complex radar backscatter and interferometry signals into actionable insights for disaster response and environmental monitoring.

(Competing solo — team roster is closed.)
